notes: Built 2026-11-04 from Nikon Instruments (Americas) pages: the specification table of each series page linked from https://www.microscope.healthcare.nikon.com/products/optics/lineup (for the Silicone Immersion and Lambda D series the table is on the /specifications subpage), plus the objective selector (https://www.microscope.healthcare.nikon.com/products/optics/selector) and its comparison pages (selector/comparison/-<ids>), which give phase ring, immersion and Ti2-E PFS compatibility. Series-page values take priority; selector values were used only for phase_ring and ti2_pfs_compatible, and every NA, WD, cover glass, correction collar and DIC value was cross-checked against the selector. Fields: mag from the model name. na is the maximum NA; na_min is given for iris (S) objectives. wd_mm and cover_glass_mm are [min,max] where the page gives a range (range limits re-ordered low to high), else a single number; wd_nominal_mm is the nominal value printed before a bracketed range. correction_collar true where the page marks a correction ring (V), false where blank. phase_ring: Ph1/Ph2/Ph3/PhL = ring inside the objective; "Ext Ph3"/"Ext Ph4" = external phase contrast, ring in the Ti2-E (page footnote: "External phase contrast observation is possible with ECLIPSE Ti2-E"); null = no phase contrast, or ring not stated. dic true where the series page Observation column lists DIC. observation is the Observation column verbatim (BF brightfield, DF darkfield, PH phase contrast, POL simple polarizing, FL fluorescence, NAMC Nikon Advanced Modulation Contrast; "*" = possible but not recommended; "**" or "^2" = external phase on Ti2-E; "^1" = possible but not recommended; "^3" = contact Nikon dealer). ti2_pfs_compatible from the selector "Ti2-E PFS Compatible" row (null = objective not in selector). Known Nikon-page inconsistencies: CFI Achromat BM 10X cover glass is 0.17 on the series page but 0.7 on the selector comparison (series page used); CFI Plan Achromat DL 20X WD is "1.2-0.17" on the selector (looks like WD and cover glass merged; series page 1.20 used); ELWD ADM 40XC and ADL 60XC WD differ by 0.01-0.02 mm from their non-phase twins as printed. Pages were read with direct HTTP fetches of the raw HTML rather than the summarizing web reader, so table cells are verbatim.
